metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the king's page, a thin Errors, the Monaghan letter, and a title from the Rose.

yesterday: You looked at the king's page and stopped.
The letter is three weeks old. Two days running, at a place in Monaghan. You copied the place and the two days, and Sly folded the letter.

Tyrone was trained in the English manner, by his cousin's account. There is talk he will be proclaimed traitor, and talk of pressing men before harvest. George kept the cousin's letter apart from what strangers added.
The Rose bill is a second part of Caesar. Richard said Rome sells.
